sample_unit: chest radiograph reports (450 ImaGenome/MIMIC-CXR plus 500 Massachusetts General Hospital)
unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting with a small number of example reports to improve LLM report labeling
Comparing open-source, locally hostable LLMs with commercial LLMs for report labeling

screen.reason: The study benchmarks and compares the accuracy of multiple commercial and open-source LLMs (with zero-shot vs few-shot prompting) on information extraction from chest radiograph reports without evaluating a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
